Definition: properly, material, i.e. (specifically) refuse haum or stalks of grain (as chopped in threshing and used for fodder)
BiblicalUsage: The word is straw, the stalk left after threshing. Pharaoh told the taskmasters to give the people no more straw to make brick, and the people cried that no straw was given to the servants, yet they were told to make brick. Rebekah told Abraham's servant there was straw and provender enough for the camels, and room to lodge in.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe straw is the measure of Pharaoh's cruelty: the work stayed the same and the straw was taken away.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
